metadata.name: getCel
metadata.description: The one read — return the live Cel at key (take .v from it). Undefined when missing.

metadata.name: setValue
metadata.description: Data-plane write (recalc tier): a ValueCel's v or a FormulaCel's f. Refuses definition cels — those are replaced via setCel.

metadata.name: setValueBatch
metadata.description: Atomic batch of setValue writes ([key, value][]); one precompute when any formula source changed, one cascade.

metadata.name: setCel
metadata.description: Cel-plane write (recompile tier): with celType, create/replace the whole cel (definition replacements bump defGeneration so consumers recompile at next fire); without celType, metadata-only edit — v/f refused.

metadata.name: setCelBatch
metadata.description: Atomic batch of setCel specs (Record<key, CelSpec>); one precompute, one cascade.

metadata.name: touch
metadata.description: Enqueue a cel onto its channels without changing it.

metadata.name: consume
metadata.description: Drain one channel's queue into the caller.

metadata.name: drain
metadata.description: Drain a channel to empty, invoking its drain fn.

metadata.name: clearErrors
metadata.description: Reset the kernel errors log.

metadata.name: f
metadata.description: Default formula parser: S-expression source → CompiledLambda. Replace to swap formula languages (provide matching extractDeps).

metadata.name: ilk
metadata.description: Short form of interlinked, for formulas: (ilk). Cels of an ilk, interlinked.

metadata.name: interlinked
metadata.description: The cascade — "a system of cels. interlinked." Fire propagation once across every fireable cel until the interlinked graph settles. Canonical name (impl: 連鎖); runCycle is a legacy alias, ilk the short form.

metadata.name: runCycle
metadata.description: Fire the full cascade once across every fireable cel.

metadata.name: hydrate
metadata.description: Inflate segments + manifests + fn maps into state.cels; lock-aware.

metadata.name: dehydrate
metadata.description: Serialize non-kernel cels and manifests to JSON-shaped 甲骨 + 冊 records.

metadata.name: hydrate函
metadata.description: Boot an application from ONE 函 artifact (version + per-segment payload sources + boot record): install entries dormant/codeSeed, wake the boot roots, apply boot.set. codeSeed missing from the host bundle fails here, before anything runs.

metadata.name: dehydrate函
metadata.description: Warm boot: emit the application as ONE 函 artifact — awake segments deflated inline, dormant payloads passed through, bundled/native as codeSeed, boot.wake = the currently-awake root cover.

metadata.name: flush
metadata.description: Tear down a segment and its dependents; fires _dispose, removes cels, precomputes.

metadata.name: wake
metadata.description: Inflate + compile a dormant segment plus its dormant dependency closure (compile.cache softens recompile), run the hydrate post-install passes, then one settle cascade over the woken cels. Idempotent; async.

metadata.name: sleep
metadata.description: Dehydrate a segment in place: _dispose each cel, deflate to a 甲骨 payload on the SegmentCel's _dormant, drop the live cels. Refuses when awake dependents exist unless { cascade: true }; user-space SCCs sleep as a unit; kernel never sleeps.

metadata.name: forget
metadata.description: Remove a segment from state: dormant ⇒ optional persist-to-sink, delete, precompute; awake ⇒ sleep-then-forget (delegates to flush). Kernel-closure guard stays.

metadata.name: getSegmentManifest
metadata.description: Read a 冊 manifest from state.segments by name.

metadata.name: listSegments
metadata.description: Return every 冊 currently loaded into state.segments.

metadata.name: findDependents
metadata.description: Walk 冊.dependencies to find every manifest that transitively depends on a given segment.

metadata.name: registerSegmentLoader
metadata.description: Park a loader (sync or async () => Cel[]) for a not-yet-installed segment in the reserved segment.loaders registry; optionally seeds its 冊 manifest.

metadata.name: loadSegment
metadata.description: Install one pending segment's cels (live code-seed cels — no compile), then run schema/memo passes and precompute. No-op when the segment isn't pending.

metadata.name: ensureSegments
metadata.description: Load every pending segment in the 冊.dependencies closure of the given names, concurrently, with a single precompute for the batch.

metadata.name: isSegmentPending
metadata.description: True when a segment's manifest is registered but its cels await loadSegment/ensureSegments.

metadata.name: loadScript
metadata.description: (url) - load an external script from a URL (a CDN) at runtime; resolves once it loads. Browser-only (injects a <script>); off-browser it resolves immediately. Idempotent per URL. The one place external libraries (Pyodide, wabt) enter the page.
